scenarios.description: an unrelated file is added; the untouched bug and clean symbol must never be re-reviewed
a sibling symbol in the same file changes; the untouched bug must still be carried forward
the body of the buggy symbol actually changes (fixed) -- must always get a real recheck, never a blind carry-forward
a change above the bug shifts its line number without changing the bug itself -- must be rechecked fresh, not lost or duplicated
the buggy symbol moves to a different file, body unchanged -- the finding must survive the move (carried forward or rechecked), never dropped
scenarios.detail: statuses_after={'calc_total subtracts instead of adding': <FindingMemoryStatus.CARRIED_FORWARD: 'carried_forward'>} prompted=[]

a rename introduces a second equally-plausible symbol of the same name -- must never silently resolve or carry forward without a fresh look
